H1 > H2 > H3 creates three levels of heading nesting

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<h1>Top Level</h1><p>Top intro.</p><h2>Mid Level</h2><p>Mid content.</p><h3>Deep Level</h3><p>Deep content.</p>", "{\"include_document_structure\":true}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
